```
private fun findBlock(text: String, keyword: String): List<String> {
    val result = mutableListOf<String>()
    val regex = Regex("""$keyword\s*\{""")
    var match = regex.find(text)
    while (match != null) {
        val start = match.range.last + 1
        val end = findMatchingBrace(text, start)
        if (end != -1) {
            result.add(text.substring(start, end))
        }
        match = match.next()
    }
    return result
}

private fun findMatchingBrace(text: String, start: Int): Int {
    var i = start
    var depth = 1
    while (i < text.length && depth > 0) {
        when (text[i]) {
            '{' -> depth++
            '}' -> depth--
        }
        i++
    }
    return if (depth == 0) i - 1 else -1
}
```

```
    private var isApplication = false
    private var hasPlayCore = false
    private var languageSplitDisabled = false

    override fun getApplicableFiles(): List<FileType> = listOf(FileType.GRADLE)

    override fun getApplicableMethodCalls(): List<String>? = listOf(
        "apply",
        "id",
        "enableSplit",
        "implementation",
        "api",
        "compile",
        "compileOnly",
        "runtimeOnly",
        "testImplementation",
        "androidTestImplementation"

        "enableSplit",

        isApplication = false
        hasPlayCore = false
        languageSplitDisabled = false
    }

        context: GradleContext,
        statement: String,
        parent: String?,
        parentParent: String?,
        namedArguments: Map<String, String>,
        unnamedArguments: List<String>,
        cookie: Any
    ) {

            statement == "apply" && namedArguments["plugin"]?.trimQuotes() == "com.android.application" -> {
                isApplication = true
            }
            statement == "id" && parent == "plugins" && unnamedArguments.any { it.trimQuotes() == "com.android.application" } -> {

            parent == "dependencies" && unnamedArguments.any { PLAY_CORE_REGEX.containsMatchIn(it.trimQuotes()) } -> {
                hasPlayCore = true
            }
            statement == "enableSplit"
                && parent == "language"
                && parentParent == "bundle"
                && unnamedArguments.any { it.trimQuotes() == "false" } -> {
                languageSplitDisabled = true
            }
        }
    }

        context: GradleContext,
        property: String,
        value: String,
        parent: String,
        parentParent: String?,
        propertyCookie: Any,
        valueCookie: Any,
        statementCookie: Any

            && parentParent == "bundle"
            && value.trimQuotes() == "false"

                    "to download additional language splits."

        }
```
